concepts.name: Mesopotamia
concepts.definition: Historical region of West Asia within the Tigris–Euphrates river system, largely modern Iraq, and cradle of some of the world's earliest civilizations.

concepts.name: Southern Cone
concepts.definition: Southernmost subregion of South America, mostly south of the Tropic of Capricorn, comprising Argentina, Chile and Uruguay (sometimes Paraguay and southern Brazil).

concepts.name: Northern Triangle of Central America
concepts.definition: Geopolitical grouping of the three Central American countries Guatemala, Honduras and El Salvador, whose borders meet at the Trifinio point.

concepts.name: Caribbean South America
concepts.definition: Subregion of South America bordering the Caribbean Sea, covering the Caribbean coasts of Colombia and Venezuela and often reckoned with the Guianas.

concepts.name: The Guianas
concepts.definition: Region of northeastern South America between the Orinoco and Amazon rivers, chiefly Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.

concepts.name: Siberia
concepts.definition: Vast, sparsely populated region of North Asia stretching from the Ural Mountains to the Pacific, covering about three-quarters of Russia's territory.

concepts.name: European Russia
concepts.definition: Western part of Russia, west of the Ural Mountains, holding about 23% of the country's territory but roughly 80% of its population.

concepts.name: Mainland Southeast Asia
concepts.definition: Continental portion of Southeast Asia, historically Indochina, comprising Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam and Peninsular Malaysia with Singapore.

concepts.name: Horn of Africa
concepts.definition: Large peninsula in easternmost Africa jutting into the Arabian Sea and Gulf of Aden, comprising Somalia, Djibouti, Ethiopia and Eritrea.

concepts.name: Sahel
concepts.definition: Semi-arid transitional belt across Africa between the Sahara to the north and the Sudanian savanna to the south, stretching from the Atlantic to the Red Sea.

concepts.name: Maghreb
concepts.definition: Western region of North Africa, comprising Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Mauritania and Western Sahara; its name means "the place where the sun sets."

concepts.name: Baltic states
concepts.definition: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, three sovereign states on the eastern coast of the Baltic Sea in Northern Europe, bordering Russia and Belarus to the east.

concepts.name: Benelux
concepts.definition: Politico-economic union of Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg in Western Europe, named for the initial syllables of its three members and rooted in a 1940s customs union.
